text:
Liam T: Ok team, starting the AU (melbourne) marketplace onboarding with EdgeGrid as the hardware partner. Need quotas, entitlement role, KMS acceptance, and a joint comms timeline.

Priya R: EdgeGrid confirmed they'll provide 6x A10G-equivalent and 10x g5x2 nodes in au-southeast-2. They'll publish an AMI and offer an edge cache layer.

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: Correct. We'll also seed an edge pool in Melbourne metro for lower tail latency. Do you have target throughput or burst patterns?

Liam T: Expectation for launch: ~6k requests/day, peak 180 r/s, average 280 tokens/request. Requesting 2x safety margin. Please size quotas accordingly.

Priya R: For the quota ticket I'll ask for 24 GPUs (mix of A10G-like and g5 family) and two EBS-optimized instances for uploads. Who will own the marketplace listing account?

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: Listing account: 111222333444. Proposed SKU: EG-MEL-LLM-02 (partner draft). KMS key for AMI encrypt: arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:111222333444:key/klmn-9876-5432.

ops-bot: Quota request created: Q-99001. Assigned to @Priya R. AWS response ETA ~48-96 hours.

Priya R: Filing now. Adding expected tps, token mix, and cost estimate. Also adding autoscale suggestion: pool-min=1, pool-max=15, prefer spot for background jobs.

Nora P: Legal note 12: if EdgeGrid holds the KMS key, we need a KMS key usage agreement and to document which telemetry (if any) leaves region. Please start a ticket to Legal with partner contact.

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: We'll accept a KMS usage attestation and can provide a key policy that restricts decrypt to the marketplace images only.

Liam T: For infra handoff, here's an example assume-role policy we asked partners to create. Please use this pattern and post the final role ARN back here:
```
{
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::555666777888:role/marketplace-deploy"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}
  ]
}
```
Attach to partner account 111222333444 and name it redwood_mel_entitlement.

Priya R: Once role is available I'll add it to the deployment pipeline and run a dry-run image import. Carlos, please confirm role creation timeline.

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: Role creation planned today, will post ARN and a short checklist (permissions, trust relationships).

ops-bot: Ticket Q-99001 status: AWS quota query opened (AQ-91234). Tentative increase: 24 GPUs.

Nora P: Also request a data flow EDD (one-page) mapping where customer prompts, logs, metrics, and models live. We need that for the DPA addendum.

Liam T: Agreed. I'll attach the EDD and a simple diagram to the legal ticket. Priya, can you add a test dataset to S3 w/ server-side encryption using the partner KMS key? We'll need it for perf runs.

Priya R: Creating bucket now: arn:aws:s3:::eg-mel-staging-212345 (server-side encryption + partner KMS). I'll add a README and test harness instructions.

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: Uploading SOC + compliance docs to the shared folder and linking to the legal ticket.

Nora P: Legal ticket LG-40212 opened for KMS addendum + DPA notes. Liam, add partner contact emails and the SOC upload link.

Priya R: Quota bumped to "requested" in our tracker. Once AWS confirms I'll spin up a small staging pool and run the perf suite tagged #mel-onboard.

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: PR/Comms: we can provide a 1-paragraph partner blurb and logo assets. Please note: EdgeGrid requests co-approval of any partner mentions.

Liam T: Proposed timeline:
- Day 0: quota request + IAM role creation + legal ticket open
- Day 2-3: AMI import + staging pool live + perf runs
- Day 6: limited canary to flagged accounts (~3% traffic)
- Day 10: full go-live & joint announcement (subject to legal sign-off)

ops-bot: Q-99001 updated: AWS quota approved (AQ-91234). Please verify instance availability.

Priya R: Quota approved. Spinning staging pool now with 4 nodes. Kicking perf suite. Will post artifacts and latency/cost numbers here.

Nora P: Legal checklist: confirm KMS key policy, DPA addendum signed, SOC certs uploaded, and public messaging approval. Marking LG-40212 as awaiting signatures.

Carlos M - EdgeGrid: Role ARN: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/redwood_mel_entitlement. AMI upload scheduled in 24h.

Liam T: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate action items in the partner onboarding doc and run a 10am sync tomorrow until launch. :rocket:

ops-bot: Q-99001 closed: quota allocation verified. Staging pool created.
